item.title: An Advanced User Guide to Thanos
item.description: 1. Aggregating Data with Query As shown above, the components that Thanos Query can connect to are: Thanos Store Gateway Thanos Query Thanos Receive Prometheus, by way of Sidecar By cascading Thanos Queries, we can perform correlated queries across components and build an extremely large monitoring system. This also means that every connected component should provide a sufficiently fast Prometheus API.
